label: NUP214::ABL1

sections.text: NUP214 encodes a nuclear pore component involved in nucleocytoplasmic transport.
ABL1 encodes a nonreceptor tyrosine kinase that regulates cell growth, adhesion and DNA-damage responses.

The fusion retains the carboxy-terminal kinase domain and creates constitutive growth signaling. NUP214::ABL1 can be amplified on episomes in T-ALL; nuclear-pore localization contributes to its activity. It also occurs in Ph-like B-ALL.
ABL-class kinase inhibition has a biological and preclinical rationale in this fusion class; treatment of Ph-like ALL with these agents is distinct from the BCR::ABL1-positive ALL drug indications.
